game_identity.player_fantasy: Be the last maintenance runner carrying unstable charge from a central core to failing relays fast enough to keep the network alive.
game_identity.central_interaction: Route, recharge, carry, and transfer charge between a central core and four decaying relay beacons while choosing which live network problem to service next.

playable_loop: Move -> recharge at core -> choose upper/lower passage -> carry charge -> read changing relay urgency -> choose which relay to service -> touch beacon to transfer -> manage decay -> stabilize all four or black out -> retry

controls.move: WASD, arrow keys, or standard-mapped gamepad left stick / D-pad
controls.restart: R, Restart button, or standard-mapped gamepad Start

technology_stack: Plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript Canvas; local/offline browser; no dependencies

accepted_runtime_anchor.summary: Accepted focus/time runtime with explicit inactive pause/no catch-up, bounded focused-time substeps, input/retry neutrality, truthful pause/recovery status, and flat relay decay still unchanged at 4.2 energy/s.

accepted_evidence.loop_closure: COMPLETED. Accepted machine evidence covers WON, ordinary BLACKOUT, retry, completion precedence, and real-browser terminal/restart inspection. Human full-session PLAYTESTED evidence remains absent.
accepted_evidence.decisionful_routing: COMPLETED. Accepted chamber geometry provides reachable upper/lower passage classes with materially different route costs and exact-composition solvability evidence.
accepted_evidence.stateful_relay_triage: COMPLETED. Accepted same-snapshot evidence shows equal-cost service choices can produce different immediate network consequences based on live relay state.
accepted_evidence.route_urgency_tradeoff: COMPLETED. Accepted evidence shows a nearby safer relay can own route/runner-charge advantage while a farther urgent relay owns network-recovery advantage; neither dominates both dimensions.
accepted_evidence.decision_chain: COMPLETED. Accepted evidence shows one service decision changes the next meaningful service decision under a comparable continuation policy.
accepted_evidence.run_consequence: COMPLETED. Accepted evidence shows an early choice can reshape several later services and then substantially reconverge; recoverable consequence is coherent and permanent divergence is not required.
accepted_evidence.adaptive_completion_characterization: COMPLETED AS DIAGNOSIS, NOT AS SUCCESS. Accepted QA PR #48 reaches a repeatable R2 > R4 > R3 > R1 non-terminal cycle under one declared state-driven policy. Accepted Systems PR #52 reaches a distinct R1/R2 starvation loop under a materially different route/deficit-aware policy. These results do not prove every possible policy fails; they are enough to stop broad heuristic shopping as the next direction.
accepted_evidence.proportional_decay_probe: ACCEPTED EVIDENCE ONLY. Systems PR #53 tested replacing flat 4.2 energy/s relay decay with 4.2 * (energy / 100) energy/s in-memory against exact accepted source. The unchanged #48 policy reached WON, the unchanged #52 policy reached ordinary BLACKOUT instead of another endless loop, scripted WON remained feasible, and ordinary BLACKOUT remained feasible. This is not yet an accepted runtime rule.
accepted_evidence.focus_time_contract: ACCEPTED AND IMPLEMENTED. Director focus/time contract plus PR #69 establish inactive pause/no catch-up, focused-time integrity through bounded substeps, input/retry neutrality, truthful pause/recovery status, spatial continuity, resource/terminal cadence equivalence, and local/offline integration smoke on the accepted focus/time composition. Accepted test-only PR #67 and PR #66 make the focused-time resource-equivalence and spatial-continuity regressions durable on main for rerun against the proportional composition.
